visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a close-up shot of a silver spoon holding a mixture of yellow custard and dark, translucent preserved egg pieces. A man with shoulder-length hair wearing a green t-shirt is visible in a small inset at the bottom right, holding a pudding cup and an egg. (2) The scene cuts to a top-down view of a white ceramic bowl on a wooden table. A whole yellow pudding is inside. A dark grey preserved egg is dropped onto it. A hand then uses a spoon to stir and vigorously mash the two ingredients into a lumpy, textured paste. (3) The man is now shown sitting on a grey sofa in a living room environment with a floor lamp behind him. He holds the bowl and takes a large spoonful of the mixture, looking directly into the camera with a surprised and delighted facial expression. (4) A tight close-up shows the mixture dripping from the spoon, emphasizing the contrast between the yellow pudding base and the dark egg fragments. (5) In a new phase, a white transition screen appears followed by the man drinking a beige-colored milk tea from a glass with a wide straw. He claps his hands and smiles broadly. (6) The camera shows milk tea being poured into a bowl containing the pudding-egg mixture. A glass is then filled with this mixture at the bottom and topped with milk tea. The man stirs the contents with a wide straw and takes several sips, looking highly satisfied.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Logo]: @threads. [Variety]: THREADS瘋傳. [Slogan]: 布丁+皮蛋. [Subtitle]: 驚為天人的好吃. (2) [Slogan]: 皮蛋+布丁 攪拌均勻. [Subtitle]: 這是嬰兒副食品? 皮蛋最新吃法. 是布丁還是皮蛋. (3) [Subtitle]: 愛真的需要勇氣. 好好吃喔. (4) [Subtitle]: 布丁軟嫩的口感. 和皮蛋蛋黃. 黏稠狀非常搭. 如果你很討厭皮蛋後面味道. 布丁甜味剛好蓋過去. 好像放進飲料. 也沒有不行喔. (5) [Slogan]: 加入鮮奶茶 馬上試喝. [Variety]: 超好喝. (6) [Subtitle]: 我覺得如果你是皮蛋愛好者. 一定要喝看看特調出來的. 布丁皮蛋鮮奶茶. 茶味和皮蛋味道. 融合在一起了. 最後還有厚度在. (7) [Subtitle]: 皮蛋獲得最新生命. 我要升天了. 這杯我就稱它為. 升天奶茶.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A high-arousal male voice begins narrating at a fast tempo over a bright, rhythmic electronic pop background track. (2) A sharp, percussive impact sound is heard as the egg is tapped against the bowl. (3) Continuous scraping and squishing sounds of a metal spoon against ceramic accompany the narration as the speaker describes the mixing process. (4) The BGM briefly transitions into a female vocal melody singing the line 'Ai zhen de xu yao yong qi' before returning to the energetic beat. (5) Audible mouth sounds and a wet chewing texture are followed by a loud, emphatic vocal exclamation. (6) A digital whoosh SFX marks a visual transition. (7) Distinct liquid pouring and bubbling sounds occur as milk tea is introduced to the mix. (8) Two sharp slurping sounds through a straw are clearly audible, followed by a final enthusiastic vocal sign-off by the speaker.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Montage: Hook -> Demonstration -> Trial -> Innovation -> Final Recommendation.
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video serves as an enthusiastic review of a viral food combination—pudding mixed with preserved egg. It aims to shock and then convince the audience that this seemingly unappetizing mixture is actually delicious, eventually elevating the trend by turning it into a milk tea beverage.

high_inference.freeDescribe: The video effectively uses high-energy editing and contrasting color palettes (yellow vs dark grey) to maintain engagement while reviewing a social media trend.
